description: A classic traditional residential front entrance photographed at standing eye-level in a centered three-quarter view. The house facade is clad in natural cut limestone or quarry stone in warm grey-white tones with irregular coursing, giving the exterior a substantial, timeless quality. A large stone archway frames the recessed entry porch, with the arch soffit paneled in painted white vertical shiplap boards. The left door has a grid of paned upper glass lights. The entry porch floor is irregular large-format bluestone or slate in cool grey-blue tones forming natural stepping stone pads leading to the front door. Entry steps rise from a low hedge-lined flagstone path. Dense trimmed boxwood hedges run low along the front of the home. A terracotta or stone pot overflowing with white chrysanthemum blooms sits at the base of the right door. A brown woven doormat rests before the threshold. A warm amber glow emanates from the left wall of the stone facade, washing light across the stone surface. The overall palette is warm grey stone, cream white paint, cool grey slate, and living green foliage.
